name: terminal_session
source_description: zsh terminal session with kubectl, docker, gh tool output
screen_text: Lead off, here's the terminal log. Ran kubectl get pods in the phoenix namespace and saw phoenix-api-7f8d9 plus phoenix-worker-d3b1f. The worker was CrashLoopBackOff after 42 restarts. Then ran docker logs phoenix-worker-d3b1f and got an error about a refused connection to database.example.com for Postgres. Opened gh pr view 1842 which was titled migrate the worker pool from Sidekiq to Oban, reviewed by Ellison at Anthropic.
